name: 执行计划退化诊断
description: 执行计划退化是生产环境最常见的突发性能问题之一。表现为 SQL 突然变慢，plan_hash_value 发生变化。常见触发因素：统计信息收集、参数变更、数据库升级、ACS/绑定变量窥视、cursor invalidation。SPM（SQL Plan Management）是预防计划退化的最佳工具。

conditions.desc: SQL 执行时间突然增加 5 倍以上

skip_when.desc: SQL 执行时间波动 < 2 倍

root_causes.name: 统计信息收集触发计划变化
root_causes.desc: DBMS_STATS 自动收集更新了表/索引统计信息，新统计导致优化器选择了不同的执行计划。通常发生在自动统计收集窗口之后。

root_causes.name: ACS/Bind Peeking 选错计划
root_causes.desc: Adaptive Cursor Sharing 或 Bind Peeking 根据某次传入的非代表性绑定值生成了不适合大多数执行的计划。

root_causes.name: 数据分布变化
root_causes.desc: 表数据量或分布发生显著变化（大批量导入/删除），原计划的假设不再成立。

root_causes.name: 参数变更或升级
root_causes.desc: optimizer_features_enable、cursor_sharing、optimizer_mode 等参数变更，或数据库版本升级引入新的优化器行为。

root_causes.name: 索引失效或新增
root_causes.desc: 索引被 drop/rebuild/invisible 或新增索引改变了优化器的选择。

step1_plan_change_history.desc: 从 AWR 查看 SQL 的执行计划变化历史
step1_plan_change_history.sql: SELECT snap_id, plan_hash_value, executions_delta, ROUND(elapsed_time_delta/GREATEST(executions_delta,1)/1000) avg_ms, buffer_gets_delta/GREATEST(executions_delta,1) avg_gets FROM dba_hist_sqlstat WHERE sql_id = '&sql_id' ORDER BY snap_id DESC FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

step2_compare_plans.sql:
SELECT * FROM TABLE(DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_AWR('&sql_id', &good_plan_hash));
SELECT * FROM TABLE(DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_AWR('&sql_id', &bad_plan_hash));

step3_stats_last_analyzed.desc: 检查相关表最近的统计信息收集时间
step3_stats_last_analyzed.sql: SELECT table_name, last_analyzed, num_rows, stale_stats FROM dba_tab_statistics WHERE owner = UPPER('&owner') AND table_name IN (&table_list) ORDER BY last_analyzed DESC

step4_optimizer_env_diff.desc: 对比两个 plan 的优化器环境差异
step4_optimizer_env_diff.sql: SELECT * FROM v$sql_optimizer_env WHERE sql_id = '&sql_id' AND child_number IN (&child1, &child2) ORDER BY name

step5_load_baseline.desc: 将好计划加载为 SQL Plan Baseline
step5_load_baseline.sql: DECLARE l PLS_INTEGER; BEGIN l := DBMS_SPM.LOAD_PLANS_FROM_AWR(begin_snap => &begin_snap, end_snap => &end_snap, basic_filter => q'[sql_id = '&sql_id']'); END;

step1_check_plan_regression.desc: 检查 Plan Regression 相关指标
step1_check_plan_regression.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS regressed_sql_count FROM (SELECT sql_id, COUNT(DISTINCT plan_hash_value) pc FROM dba_hist_sqlstat WHERE snap_id > (SELECT MAX(snap_id)-48 FROM dba_hist_snapshot) GROUP BY sql_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT plan_hash_value) > 1)
